convert_markdown_to_html: convert a markdown string to HTML using the markdown function with optional extensions and output format
convert_markdown_file_to_html: convert a markdown file to HTML and write output to a file using markdownFromFile with input and output paths
create_markdown_parser_instance: create a Markdown parser instance with custom extensions, tab length, and output format settings
register_markdown_extension: register a custom markdown extension with the parser instance to add new preprocessing or postprocessing capabilities
set_markdown_output_format: set the output format of the Markdown parser to html or xhtml using set_output_format
